source: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II. UCI Machine Learning Repository. DOI: 10.24432/C5CG6D
notes: UCI describes an anonymized UK-based registered non-store online retailer that mainly sells all-occasion giftware; many customers are wholesalers.
Target for modelling is recorded positive sales quantity, not unconstrained demand; stockouts and lost sales are not observed.
Exact duplicate rows are removed only in the analytical copy; raw workbook remains unchanged.
C-prefixed invoices are cancellations. Negative quantities on non-C invoices are retained for separate returns/adjustment analysis, not included in positive sales target.
Non-merchandise codes such as postage, fees, discounts, vouchers and manual adjustments require explicit catalogue review before final SKU training.
First and last weekly buckets are partial; excluded from 102 complete weekly buckets.
No on-hand inventory, purchase orders, supplier lead times, procurement costs, margin or lost-sales fields are present.
The dataset covers 2009-2011 and is historical, not evidence of current 2026 demand.
